topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I just heard about what happened with your car, and I can’t help but think about the time I had a similar issue. I know how much it can upset your day, making you feel like you’re standing there, helpless, wondering how things went so wrong so quickly. I wish I could have warned you, maybe suggested checking the restrictions or signs, if there were any. It’s such a tricky situation, especially when it feels like it should be a safe spot. I hope you’re able to sort it out soon and that everything works out alright.
